a.content: The Abracon ABM8-272-T3 crystal has a centre frequency of 12.000 MHz.
a.source:
Table 257. Key Crystal Specifications. Parameters Minimum Typical Maximum Units Notes
Center Frequency 12.000 12.000 12.000 MHz

b.content: The recommended Abracon crystal runs at 12MHz.
b.source: the RP2040 reference design (see the Minimal Design Example in Hardware design with RP2040) uses a 12MHz crystal

notes: A precision-only difference: 12.000 MHz in the specification table and 12MHz in the prose two paragraphs above it, about the same crystal in the same document. LABELLING.md section 2 says a precision difference is not a conflict, and here it is not even a distinct fact.
